name: com.vigilbase/mcp
title: Vigilbase
description: Website and email security checks for any domain. One customers also review Cloudflare security.

tools.name: list_security_tools
tools.description: The Vigilbase Agent API catalog: which tools run here, their inputs, your auth tier, current rate limits and scan quota, and your daily scan allowance (5 a day per network, 50 a day per Vigilbase account when signed in).

tools.name: run_security_headers
tools.description: Fetch a URL and grade its HTTP security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy and more). Returns grade, gradeScore out of 100 and the full result. Spends one scan from your daily allowance (5 per network, or 50 per Vigilbase account when signed in) and the hourly per-IP and per-target quotas.

target.description: URL or domain to check, for example https://example.com. https:// is assumed without a scheme.

tools.name: run_email_security
tools.description: Look up and grade a domain's email authentication: SPF, DKIM and DMARC. Returns grade, gradeScore out of 100 and the full result. Spends one scan from your daily allowance (5 per network, or 50 per Vigilbase account when signed in) and the hourly per-IP and per-target quotas.

target.description: Domain whose SPF, DKIM and DMARC records to grade, for example example.com.

tools.name: get_security_badge
tools.description: The SVG badge showing a domain's latest verified Website Security grade ("?" when there is none), its URL and HTML to embed it.

domain.description: Domain, for example example.com. A leading www. is ignored.

style.description: Badge style: default (56 px), compact (44 px) or mini (28 px).

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search docs.vigilbase.com (Tools, One, OS, the APIs, CLI and this MCP server) through the Docs API (https://docs.vigilbase.com/tools/developers/docs-api). Returns pages best first, each with its path, URL and the heading the match is under. Read one with get_docs_page.

query.description: Words to find in docs.vigilbase.com, for example "org api keys". Every word must appear in a page.

tools.name: get_docs_page
tools.description: One page of docs.vigilbase.com as Markdown, with absolute links, by the path search_docs returned. Uses the Docs API (https://docs.vigilbase.com/tools/developers/docs-api).

path.description: The page path from a search result, for example one/api. Empty is the docs home.
